model.name: Task 30.46: Working-file diff — left=latest resolves to the on-disk working file (uncommitted)
model.description: The diff editor's LEFT side supports the live on-disk working file. A 'latest'/'working' pseudo-ref makes loadSide read the raw uncommitted file via /api/files (NOT git show <ref>:file), resolveBase treats working/'' as no-ref (2-way); saving with left=working round-trips that same file to disk (reuses R30.38 save PUT, no code change); opening a diff DEFAULTS left=working pinned + right=HEAD (a _pinnedLeft flag suppresses the R30.17 auto-promote); the left picker is repurposed to pick the RIGHT compare-ref.
